title: Psychologist visit
what: A specialist who helps you work through feelings, relationships, and hard situations by talking. They are not a doctor and do not prescribe medicines.
why: For stress, anxiety, relationship problems, grief, a crisis, or behavior problems in children.
duration: a session usually lasts 50 to 60 minutes; you decide together how many sessions
tell_doctor: What brought you, and what you want to change
Past visits to a psychologist or psychiatrist
If you have thoughts of harming yourself, say so right away

prepare.title: Your goal
prepare.text: Think about what you want to come with. If it is hard to put into words, that is normal. You will work it out together.

prepare.title: For a child
prepare.text: For parents: often you come together the first time, sometimes first without the child. Ask in advance.

prepare.title: Place
prepare.text: For an online session, find a quiet place where no one can overhear you.

bring: Your ID, if the clinic asks
A notebook, if you want to take notes
steps: You get to know each other and talk about what bothers you
The specialist explains how the work will go
You talk at your own pace
You agree on the next session
feel: It can be hard to talk about personal things. That is normal
After a session, you may feel tired or relieved
after: Results usually show after a few sessions
You can change specialists if it does not feel right
red_flags: Thoughts of harming yourself: do not wait for the session. Call emergency services

faq.q: How many sessions will I need?
faq.a: It varies: from a few to many months. Discuss it with your psychologist.
No. If medicine is needed, they will suggest seeing a psychiatrist or psychotherapist.

reminders.text: Psychologist session tomorrow. Think about what you want to talk about.
